meta.name: game-design
meta.description: Game design principles. GDD structure, balancing, player psychology, progression.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 掌握游戏设计原则,打造平衡有趣的玩法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正设计游戏,希望让机制平衡且玩家体验流畅。
copy.tagline_en: Master game design principles to craft balanced, engaging gameplay.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're designing games and want to keep mechanics balanced and players engaged.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按游戏设计原则来帮忙:用 30 秒测试梳理核心循环,按标准结构写游戏设计文档,分析玩家动机、奖励与难度曲线,规划进度系统,并提示常见设计反模式。
howto.when: 当用户谈到游戏设计时触发,例如请求设计核心玩法、撰写游戏设计文档、或询问难度平衡等问题时,Claude 会套用这套原则回答。

say.text: 帮我设计一个平台跳跃游戏的核心循环。
say.note: 会按动作-反馈-奖励的 30 秒测试给出结构。

say.text: 写一份游戏设计文档,包含机制、进度和美术方向。
say.note: 会按 GDD 的六个板块生成内容。

say.text: 这个游戏到后期太难了,怎么调整难度曲线?
say.note: 会结合心流理论和平衡策略给建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude applies game-design principles: uses the 30-second test to shape core loops, drafts GDDs with standard sections, analyzes player motivation, reward schedules, difficulty flow, and progression systems, and flags common anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: It activates when the user raises game-design topics, such as asking for a core loop, a GDD, or difficulty balancing; Claude then answers using these principles.

say_en.text: Design a core loop for a platformer.
Write a GDD with mechanics, progression, and art style.
say_en.note: It covers the standard GDD sections.

say_en.text: How do I tune the difficulty for late game?
say_en.note: It applies flow state and balancing strategies.
